chunks: There is no one for whom death becomes present except that Iblis appoints for him, from among his devils, one who commands him to kufr and causes him to doubt his religion until his soul departs. So when you are present with your dying ones, prompt them with the shahadah that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, until they die.

key_terms.إِبْلِيسُ: Iblis, the devil who seeks to mislead human beings
key_terms.الْمَوْتُ: death, the final moment when the soul departs
key_terms.دِينِهِ: his religion, the faith to which a person adheres
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, referring to Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.شَهَادَةَ: the testimony of faith to be prompted to the dying person
key_terms.شَيَاطِينِهِ: his devils, the agents of Iblis who tempt and mislead

ai.seo_question: What should be recited to a dying person at the time of death in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that the moment of death is a time of spiritual trial, when Iblis seeks to cast doubt into a person's din. He therefore instructs believers to prompt the dying with the shahadah so that they remain firm in iman at the final moment.
